title: WTO | 20th anniversary of the WTO
content:
WTO | 20th anniversary of the WTO
In 2015, the WTO commemorated its 20th anniversary. During the year, a series of events were held, such as book launches, conferences, exhibitions and other specially organized activities, focusing on various aspects of the WTO's work over the past two decades.
Some of the key events over the  past 20 years
Tenth Ministerial Conference takes place in Nairobi, Kenya. 
Kazakhstan becomes the WTOs 162nd member.
Seychelles becomes the WTO’s 161st member.
Yemen becomes the WTO’s 160th member.
Agreement on Government Procurement
Revised WTO Agreement on Government Procurement enters into force.
Ninth Ministerial Conference takes place in Bali, Indonesia. “Bali Package” adopted.
Roberto Azevêdo (Brazil) takes office as WTO Director-General.
Eighth Ministerial Conference takes place in Geneva
ldquo;Chairs Programme” launched to support developing country universities.
Seventh Ministerial Conference
Seventh Ministerial Conference takes place in Geneva.
DG Pascal Lamy reappointed for second term of four years.
Global Review of Aid for Trade
First Global Review of Aid for Trade takes place in Geneva.
Viet Nam becomes the WTO’s 150st member
First WTO Public Forum takes place in Geneva.
Sixth Ministerial Conference takes place in Hong Kong, China. Aid for Trade initiative is launched. Hong Kong Declaration is approved
Pascal Lamy (France) becomes WTO Director-General.
Fifth Ministerial Conference takes place in Cancún, Mexico
Supachai Panitchpakdi (Thailand) is elected WTO Director-General.
Fourth Ministerial Conference in Doha, Qatar. Doha Development Agenda is launched.
Negotiations begin on agriculture.
Negotiations begin on services.
Mike Moore (New Zealand) becomes WTO Director-General.
Third Ministerial Conference takes place in Seattle, US.
Second Ministerial Conference takes place in Geneva
70 WTO members reach a multilateral agreement to open their financial services sector.
First Ministerial Conference takes place in Singapore.
Renato Ruggiero (Italy) takes office as WTO Director-General.
Marrakesh Agreement establishing the WTO is signed.
